answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the beacon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The cipher index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 192 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the nadir. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
